Engage in continuing professional development (CPD) related to AI literacy, including the capabilities and limitations of AI tools and their pedagogical or ethical, and disciplinary implications.

Model responsible and transparent use of Generative AI in teaching materials and interactions with students, including clear disclosure when AI-generated output is used in lectures or learning resources.

Students on placement and work-based projects or equivalent should check the policy and approach to the use of AI tools of the placement provider or employer and ensure that their behaviour and practice whilst in the workplace also aligns with that policy.
